message.content:
This editorial illustration features the cover of "TEMPO" magazine. The background is a dark teal, starry sky over a silhouette of foliage. At the center, a light gray lattice transmission tower stands vertically. It has cross-braced sections and four rectangular panels attached to its sides. At the top of the tower are two small circular lights, one pink and one blue.

Layered over the scene are several glowing light-blue outlines of human profiles, facing right. These outlines are concentric, expanding outwards from the tower. The large, gray word "TEMPO" is positioned at the top center. Smaller white text above reads "Gerilya Perusahaan Tembakau di RUU Kesehatan H.24" and "Setelah Bank Syariah Indonesia Diretas H.68".

In the bottom left, large white block letters read "PARA PENIKMAT PROYEK PEMANCAR". Below this, a smaller paragraph of white text begins with "Setelah sempat tersendat..." and mentions "Johnny Plate." The bottom right corner displays the date "29 MEI-4 JUNI 2023," the price "RP 50.000," a barcode, and a QR code.
